Name: UpgradeSwordTools
Author: MD0uroa
Description:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> Upgrade Sword Tools (v1.2.0 Release Candidate ) <

Ever felt like your favorite weapons fall short in the late game, or wished Clint could work his blacksmithing magic on your combat gear just like he does with your regular tools? Upgrade Sword Tools brings full weapon modification directly to Clint's Blacksmith shop with a balanced, immersive, and vanilla-friendly system! No longer limited to just swords, you can now forge the ultimate arsenal to conquer the deepest floors of the Skull Cavern.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

> 🚀 Key Features <

- Multi-Weapon Support: Clint's forge now accepts Swords, Daggers, and Clubs/Hammers! Upgrade whatever weapon fits your playstyle.
- Custom Forge UI: Adds a new "Upgrade Weapon" option when talking to Clint, opening a neat, compact 12-slot container interface to place your weapon and materials.
- Dynamic Stat Scaling & Balancing: Drop processing materials (Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium Bars, Gems, or rare Minerals) along with your weapon to dynamically recalculate and boost Min/Max Damage, Critical Chance, Weapon Speed, and Knockback attributes!
- Skull Cavern Ready (Stat Caps): High-tier materials like Iridium Bars and Prismatic Shards give massive damage boosts. Built-in attribute clamping (-30 to +80 Damage max per upgrade) ensures your weapons become absolute monster-slayers without breaking game balance.
- In-Game Config (GMCM Support): Fully integrated with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. Don't want the default 3,000g fee? You can dynamically adjust the gold cost slider directly from the in-game options menu!
- Exploit & Loophole Protection: Strictly requires at least 1 material to process an upgrade (no more free upgrades!).
    * Blocks non-combat utilities (Pickaxes, Hoes, Axes, Fishing Rods).
    * Explicitly blacklists Scythes from being upgraded.
    * Completely prevents multi-weapon insertion exploits.
- Smart UI Integration: The upgrade option automatically hides itself if Clint is already actively busy working on another tool upgrade for you.
- Inventory Safety Fallback: When claiming your completed weapon, Clint will explicitly warn you if your inventory is full. The weapon will safely spawn as physical item debris at your feet so it never gets lost!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> 🛠️ How to Use <

1. Walk up to Clint at the Blacksmith shop during business hours.
2. Select the new Upgrade Weapon dialogue prompt.
3. Place exactly 1 Weapon (Sword, Dagger, or Club) and at least 1 upgrade material (Bars/Gems) into the 12-slot container interface.
4. Make sure you have enough gold in your pocket (Default: 3,000g, customizable via GMCM).
5. Click the OK button to seal the deal and trigger the forge hammer sound effect.
6. Come back in 1–3 days (scaled dynamically based on your material value) to pick up your newly enhanced weapon!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> 📦 Installation & Requirements <

- SMAPI (v4.0.0 or higher)
- Stardew Valley v1.6+
- Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, but highly recommended to change upgrade costs in-game)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> Instructions <

1. Download and extract the mod file.
2. Drop the `UpgradeSwordTools` folder directly into your Stardew Valley `Mods` directory.
3. Launch the game via SMAPI!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> 🔄 Compatibility <

- Fully compatible with [b]UI Info Suite 2[/b] (safely tracks and displays Clint's upgrade progress overlay on your calendar/HUD without conflicts).
- Fully compatible with [b]Content Patcher[/b] and major expansion mods like [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b]
